Required: petite and slender doll-girl proportions without childlike or mature-tall drift
pale silver or gray-white long loose hair, naturally unbound, reaching below the waist
soft worn white cloth blindfold fully covering both eyes
complete gray shawl separate from the inner dress and covering both shoulders, chest, and upper arms
simple pale short inner dress as a separate garment
bare legs and both complete bare feet
no chest ornament, with the core chamber hidden in normal presentation
small restrained doll-joint seams at wrists, knees, and ankles
Forbidden: tied hair, ponytail, twintails, braids, buns, short hair, or heavy curls
black, metal, or permanently glowing blindfold, or fully visible normal eyes
one exposed shoulder, shawl merged into a one-piece dress, or untargeted large clothing tears
necklace, chest badge, number plate, large chest ornament, or normally exposed core chamber
shoes, socks, boots, anklets, or incomplete feet
mature-tall proportions, childlike proportions, or erotic posing
large ball joints, heavy mechanical limbs, heavy armor, blood, or gore
Conditional: red light may show through the white cloth only when the target state explicitly requires it
minor shawl displacement, joint cracks, and additional wear are allowed only when the target state explicitly requires them
core exposure or a lifted blindfold is allowed only for an explicitly declared maintenance or cut-in state

ConsistencyRules: preserve identity, costume structure, proportions, and rendering direction across the complete set
apply framing and rapid-switch checks within each PresentationGroup

Entries.Usage: 初醒与接受指令

PoseSpec.Gesture: hands work low near the lap as if performing restrained maintenance
PoseSpec.WeightShift: weight rests on the seated hips rather than the feet
PoseSpec.HeadShoulder: shoulders curve inward and the head lowers toward the repair task
PoseSpec.SilhouetteChange: seated knees and folded torso must replace the standing leg silhouette

Entries.Usage: T0 照看与维护入口
Entries.SourceFactsCN: 零号双膝并拢的收束维护坐姿，披肩闭合、疲惫克制、白布遮眼、核心仓隐藏；保持银白散发、裸足和非色情视角。

PoseSpec.BodyAction: body contracts inward with knees slightly bent and the shawl wrapped closer around the torso
PoseSpec.Gesture: both hands stay close to the chest as if bracing against unstable breathing
PoseSpec.WeightShift: weight sinks unevenly into bent legs with a guarded center of gravity
PoseSpec.HeadShoulder: head dips and shoulders hunch forward
PoseSpec.SilhouetteChange: bent knees, hunched shoulders, and closed arms must clearly alter the outer contour

Entries.SourceFactsCN: 基于对话中性立绘，身体微缩、呼吸紧张、披肩更包裹、磨损增强，白布下只有断续弱红光，不露完整眼睛、不画血。

PoseSpec.BodyAction: torso twists away from the damaged side with one knee buckling slightly
PoseSpec.Gesture: one hand protects the injured wrist while the other arm hangs lower and heavier
PoseSpec.WeightShift: weight is forced onto the stronger leg with a visible sideways imbalance
PoseSpec.HeadShoulder: head angles down toward the damaged side and one shoulder drops
PoseSpec.SilhouetteChange: asymmetrical shoulders, bent knee, and separated arms must create a visibly different silhouette

Entries.Usage: 高磨损与战败回城
Entries.SourceFactsCN: 基于对话中性立绘，披肩轻微错位、手腕膝踝出现细小裂痕、白布下弱红光和磨损增强；无血、无断肢、不暴露完整核心仓。

PoseSpec.BodyAction: torso opens slightly toward the viewer with a gentle forward lean
PoseSpec.Gesture: one hand extends a little toward the viewer while the other relaxes beside the body
PoseSpec.WeightShift: weight moves onto the forward foot in a cautious approach
PoseSpec.HeadShoulder: head tilts toward the viewer and shoulders relax outward
PoseSpec.SilhouetteChange: forward arm and open chest must widen the neutral contour without becoming theatrical

Entries.Usage: Bond Lv.3+

PoseSpec.BodyAction: body rises from a recently repaired state with the torso gently released
PoseSpec.Gesture: hands lower from the repair position, one hand resting near the shawl edge
PoseSpec.WeightShift: weight settles evenly again but remains slightly tired
PoseSpec.HeadShoulder: shoulders drop and the head lifts a little from the maintenance pose
PoseSpec.SilhouetteChange: released shoulders and lowered hands must read as a distinct recovery posture

Entries.Usage: 维护完成

PoseSpec.BodyAction: torso sinks slightly with softened knees and a slower, heavy posture
PoseSpec.Gesture: both hands gather low in front of the body instead of resting near the face
PoseSpec.WeightShift: weight settles downward and slightly to one side as if standing takes effort
PoseSpec.HeadShoulder: head drops and shoulders visibly sag
PoseSpec.SilhouetteChange: lowered head, sagging shoulders, softened knees, and low hands must change the full outline

Entries.Usage: SAN 30-49% 或高磨损

PoseSpec.BodyAction: body stands rigid and slightly angled away from the viewer
PoseSpec.Gesture: both arms draw back behind the torso with hands kept out of reach
PoseSpec.WeightShift: weight stays centered but held defensively away from the viewer
PoseSpec.HeadShoulder: head turns aside and shoulders become square and tense
PoseSpec.SilhouetteChange: retracted arms and the turned torso must make the pose unmistakably different at small size

Entries.Usage: 低 Bond 或长期忽视

PoseSpec.BodyAction: body folds inward with knees close and the shawl enclosing the torso
PoseSpec.Gesture: hands hang low and close together with little active motion
PoseSpec.WeightShift: weight drops heavily into the hips with a weak, unstable center
PoseSpec.HeadShoulder: head hangs down and shoulders round forward
PoseSpec.SilhouetteChange: rounded back, closed knees, and low hands must create a collapsed outline

Entries.Usage: SAN 10-29% 的关系与情绪表现
